entities.name: Mátyás Timár
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mátyás Tímár was a Hungarian politician and economist, who served as Minister of Finance between 1962 and 1967, and Deputy Prime Minister since April 1967. He also held the office of Governor of the Hungarian National Bank from 10 July 1975 to 15 June 1988.

entities.summary: Mátyás Tímár was a Hungarian politician and economist, who served as Minister of Finance between 1962 and 1967, and Deputy Prime Minister since April 1967. He also held the office of Governor of the Hungarian National Bank from 10 July 1975 to 15 June 1988.
